power_statement: Over 2.0 years at 0.31% annualised volatility, the standard error of the mean return is 0.22%/yr. Power to detect a 1.0%/yr edge at alpha=0.05 is 99.4%; the smallest effect detectable at 80% power is 0.62%/yr. A null result here means the design could not resolve an edge of the size sought, not that no edge exists.
